req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint returns HTTP 204 on success and HTTP 404 when the task does not exist. The source shows crud.delete_task returns bool; the handler raises 404 if False. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing task yields 204 and the task is gone; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent task yields 404 with correct detail; (3) boundary BVA — delete task with id=1 (lowest valid id boundary); (4) STC — delete then re-delete same id confirms state transition to 'deleted'; (5) DT — verify response body is empty on 204 (no accidental body mutation). All assertions use exact values to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutants.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ before deletion
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title to obtain a task_id
trace: R-TASK-013: system shall delete the task and respond with confirmation when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

from app.database import get_db
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204():
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Task to delete', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()['id']
    del_r = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert del_r.status_code == 204
    assert del_r.content == b''
    get_r = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert get_r.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_task_returns_204()

GET /tasks/{task_b_id} to verify task B still exists

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_task_does_not_affect_other_tasks():
    ra = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Task A', 'completed': False})
    assert ra.status_code == 201
    id_a = ra.json()['id']
    rb = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Task B', 'completed': True})
    assert rb.status_code == 201
    id_b = rb.json()['id']
    del_r = client.delete(f'/tasks/{id_a}')
    assert del_r.status_code == 204
    get_b = client.get(f'/tasks/{id_b}')
    assert get_b.status_code == 200
    body_b = get_b.json()
    assert body_b['id'] == id_b
    assert body_b['title'] == 'Task B'
    assert body_b['completed'] == True

test_delete_task_does_not_affect_other_tasks()
